sources.title: Commonwealth Code, 1 CMC § 311 Legal Holidays (CNMI Law Revision Commission)
sources.said: The following days of each year are hereby declared as legal holidays within the Commonwealth: New Year’s Day January 1; Martin Luther King, Jr. Day Third Monday in January; President’s Day Third Monday in February; Commonwealth Covenant Day March 24; Good Friday As Designated in the Annual Calendar; Memorial Day Last Monday in May; Independence Day July 4; Labor Day First Monday in September; Commonwealth Cultural Day Second Monday in October; Citizenship Day November 4; Veteran’s Day November 11; Thanksgiving Day Fourth Thursday in November; Constitution Day December 8; Christmas Day December 25. Source: PL 1-11, § 2; ... PL 5-14, § 4; PL 5-21, § 3; PL 15-4, § 2.

sources.title: Office of the Governor, CNMI, Memorandum GOV2025-302, 2026 Legal Holidays (3 October 2025; a scan, read as an image)
sources.said: Pursuant to 1 CMC § 311, the following legal holidays are observed in the Commonwealth for the calendar year of 2026. Please note that schools and government offices are closed on these days. New Year’s Day Thursday, January 1; Martin Luther King, Jr. Day Monday, January 19; President’s Day Monday, February 16; Commonwealth Covenant Day Tuesday, March 24; Good Friday Friday, April 3; Memorial Day Monday, May 25; Juneteenth Friday, June 19; Independence Day (Saturday, July 4, 2026) to be observed on Friday July 3; Labor Day Monday, September 7; Commonwealth Cultural Day Monday, October 12; Citizenship Day Wednesday, November 4; Veteran’s Day Wednesday, November 11; Thanksgiving Day Thursday, November 26; Constitution Day Tuesday, December 8; Christmas Day Friday, December 25, 2026.
